description: TACO OS Shell Suite — the agentic Omarchy shell. Executable defaults for the suite: plugin inventory, vendoring policy, lifecycle policy.

repository.note: Repo root deliberately ships no manifest.json: a native `omarchy plugin add` must fail rather than install a partial/misleading plugin. Installation is transactional via scripts/taco-suite (Shibumi law).

vendoring.policy: self-contained plugins (Shibumi L1): a plugin may not import from a sibling or the repo root; shared/ is deterministically vendored into plugin dirs by scripts/sync-taco-vendored with a drift check in tests/

dependencyDirection: panels may consume services; services do not import panels (Shibumi L2)

settings.pattern: FileView + JsonAdapter (Quickshell v0.3.0 contract), writeAdapter() persistence

lifecycle.transactional: a failed install/update restores the prior working suite from backup
